synopsis: Fraunhofer ITWM offers RODOS as a human-in-the-loop driving simulator, and the glossary identifies it as an operator-in-the-loop simulator option [f8820, f16047]. The booklet places RODOS alongside InVerS and VMC among off-road-relevant research projects, with the institute pages classified as vendor evidence [f8694, f16078]. The glossary also situates RODOS within a broader ITWM capability portfolio that includes construction-site digital twins, real-data scenes and Demify soil simulation [f16113]. Human-in-the-loop simulators such as RODOS may be needed to assess warning-then-brake human factors, but the stated need remains uncertain rather than established [f9379].

relations.note: Both identify Fraunhofer ITWM RODOS as a human-in-the-loop simulator.
Both group ITWM's InVerS, RODOS and VMC as relevant research projects.
Adds a possible warning-then-brake human-factors use for the operator-in-the-loop option.
Places the offered simulator within ITWM's broader simulation capability portfolio.
Availability of a human-in-the-loop simulator supports its consideration for human-factors assessment.
